description: This source file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue page in an online examination system. It manages session validation, database interactions related to course queues, and page navigation.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling session validation, course queue checks, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks session variables, validates course queue data, and possibly deletes records if the queue is empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Reloads the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in GridView1; stores selected student ID and course ID in session and redirects to ShowAns.aspx.
